landing.heroTitle: GST billing made simple for every Indian shop
landing.heroSubtitle: Make GST invoices in seconds, share them on WhatsApp, track stock and file returns — on your phone or computer, in your own language.
landing.trust2: Free plan forever: 50 invoices a month
landing.f1Desc: Tax invoice, bill of supply, estimate, credit note and delivery challan with automatic CGST / SGST / IGST.
landing.f2Desc: Barcode scan, cash / UPI / card, thermal 58 mm and 80 mm receipts.
landing.f3Desc: Send the bill PDF and payment reminders to customers in one tap.
landing.f4Desc: Product list with HSN and GST rate, low-stock alerts, purchase bills.
landing.f5Desc: Month-end GST summaries and exports for your accountant.
landing.f6Desc: Use the app in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali or Gujarati.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Start with a 30-day free trial of Pro. After that, stay on Free or pick a plan.
landing.q1: Is there really a free plan?
landing.a1: Yes. After your 30-day trial you can keep using the Free plan: 50 invoices a month for 1 business. Bills carry a small “Made with GST Billing Pro” line.
landing.q2: Do I need a GSTIN to use it?
landing.a2: No. Shops without GST registration can make a bill of supply or simple bills. Add your GSTIN any time later.
landing.q3: Can I use it on my mobile?
landing.a3: Yes. It works in any modern browser on Android, iPhone and computers, and can be installed like an app.
landing.a4: Your data is stored in a secure cloud database and only your account can read it. You can export a full backup any time.
landing.a5: The app screens are available in 9 languages. Invoices can be printed with labels in English, Hindi, Tamil, Marathi or Bengali.
landing.a6: Pay securely with UPI, cards or net banking through Razorpay. You get a receipt by e-mail.
landing.testimonialsPlaceholder: Testimonials coming soon — we only publish real reviews from real customers.
landing.madeIn: Made in Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu, for shops across India.
